author: The author field holds the name
role: The role field holds the job title
text: Portrait, name, role, one line on what the person handles, and buttons to call or write. The name is a heading, so it appears in the heading list.
note: The portrait has an empty alt text. Screen readers announce the name next, so describing the photo would only get in the way.
